concept: SNS + SQS fan-out: independent consumers with a buffer
tests: Choosing a pattern to deliver one event to multiple independent consumers with a durable backlog.
expected: SNS topic → three SQS queues (one per consumer). Publish once, each has its own durable buffer, easy to add new ones. Triggers: "three independent consumers", "each receive", "own buffered, durable backlog".
why_not: One shared queue means each message goes to only one consumer; a synchronous Lambda call is tight coupling with no buffer; SNS→Lambda without queues gives fan-out but no durable per-consumer buffer.
